players.note: "The Seagull" is widely known as one of the best NCAA Juniors players in his class, winning three straight MVPs and championships with the Letran Squires. However, after suffering a torn ACL in his senior year of high school, he decided to declare for the Adamson Soaring Falcons under the guidance of coach Nash Racela.

Terrence Joson is known as the modern-day King Archer, guiding DLSU to two championships in four years. Now, in his fifth and final playing year, he is expected to lead the Green Archers to another championship.

Jamu "The General" Coronel.

De La Salle Zobel (DLSZ) standout in the UAAP juniors, winning two MVPs and two championships. Now he is one of the highly-touted rookies in the seniors.

Adijemu "Soar" Kojidie has been playing in the Philippine amateur leagues since he was 14, playing for the Adamson juniors team since his freshman year of high school. Now, as a Seniors Division rookie, Soar is expected to be one of the best FSAs in the league.

Rhylen "Rhymes" Shamar is a California born-and-raised basketball player who decided to pla in the Philippines in college. Widely touted as a stretch-four, Shamar brings to the Archers his 3-level scoring and keen defensive ability.
